title: LAT decision-engine rule
description: A single decision-engine rule. A rule fires when its `when` clause evaluates true against a parsed log bundle and produces a verdict + evidence + fix.

id.description: Globally unique kebab-case slug. Stable across rule edits; bumped only on semantic identity change.

scope.description: Analysis engine that owns the rule. Drives module routing in the UI.

confidence.description: Authoring confidence 0-100. Multiplied by specificity in the ranker. Baseline rules should be >=70.

version.description: Rule body version, bumped on edit. Major.minor; used by incident-replay to detect schema drift.

authoredAt.description: ISO-8601 date the rule was first authored or last edited.

authoredBy.description: Identifier for the rule author. Free-form; brand convention is a short handle.

source.description: Origin of the rule. Local overlay always wins on conflict regardless of source.

when.description: Boolean evaluation: ALL of `all` AND NONE of `none` AND (empty(any) OR ANY of `any`).

causalOrder.description: Earliest to latest. Hint to the ranker for tie-break and to the verdict card for the evidence ordering.

verdict.description: One-sentence plain-English root cause. Shown as the verdict card headline.

evidence.description: Shortlist of log entries the verdict card surfaces. Each entry is matched against parsed log lines at evaluation time.

match.description: Substring or regex matched against entry.Message.

isRegex.description: Treat `match` as a regex when true. Default false (substring).

fix.description: Suggested remediation, one short paragraph. Shown beneath the verdict.

references.description: Authoritative URLs (MS Learn preferred). Surfaced as `Read more` links on the verdict card.

condition.description: A single condition in a `when` clause. Discriminator field selects the type.

signature.description: Signature ID from SignatureDB/log-signatures.json that must have fired.

errorCode.description: Error code (decimal or 0xHEX) from any ErrorCodes/*.json that must have appeared.

component.description: Optional component scope to constrain the match.

probe.description: Probe name from the root-cause probe registry.

result.description: Required probe result (typically `Fail`, `Pass`, `Warn`, or a specific string).

cluster.description: Event template ID from EventDB/event-definitions.json that Group-LogEvents produced.

pattern.description: Regex matched against entry.Message in that component.

timeGap.description: Two signatures fired within `maxSec` seconds, in order.
